sentences.en: Welcome to the first episode of the Kickstarter-funded Season 4 of 99% Invisible, now weekly from here on out.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收看由Kickstarter资助的《99%隐形》第四季的第一集，从现在开始我们将改为周播。

sentences.en: And I'm excited to announce the launch of Radiotopia from PRX, a collective of the best story-driven audio shows on the planet.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴地宣布，来自PRX的Radiotopia正式上线，这是一个汇集了全球最优秀的叙事音频节目的联盟。

sentences.en: We'll have more information about Radiotopia at the end of the show, so thank you all for your generosity and support.
sentences.zh: 我们在节目结束时会提供更多关于Radiotopia的信息，感谢大家的慷慨与支持。

sentences.en: We're gonna make you proud.
sentences.zh: 我们不会让大家失望的。

sentences.en: Here we go.
sentences.zh: 我们开始吧。

sentences.en: Radiotopia.
sentences.zh: Radiotopia。

sentences.en: From PRX.
sentences.zh: 来自PRX。

sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: The greatness of New York is perhaps most spectacularly seen in its buildings.
sentences.zh: 纽约的伟大，或许在其建筑中得到了最壮观的体现。

sentences.en: While other cities have spread outward, New York has been forced to build upward.
sentences.zh: 当其他城市向外扩张时，纽约却被迫向上建造。

sentences.en: Like the best of these stories, the two bitter rivals started out as best friends.
sentences.zh: 就像所有精彩的故事一样，这两个死对头最初也是最好的朋友。

sentences.en: William Van Allen.
sentences.zh: 威廉·范·阿伦。

sentences.en: Van Allen was kind of the archetype of architect as artiSt.
sentences.zh: 范·阿伦可以说是艺术家型建筑师的典范。

sentences.en: He looked at buildings as art, and he wanted to revolutionize in that way.
sentences.zh: 他把建筑视为艺术，并希望以此带来一场革命。

sentences.en: And Craig Severance.
sentences.zh: 还有克雷格·塞弗伦斯。

sentences.en: Craig Severance was very much architect as businessman.
sentences.zh: 克雷格·塞弗伦斯非常符合商人型建筑师的形象。

sentences.en: He looked at buildings as a way to make the land pay.
sentences.zh: 他将建筑视为让土地产生效益的途径。

sentences.en: They were business partners.
sentences.zh: 他们是商业伙伴。

sentences.en: And as partners, they were incredible together because you had Van Allen as the architect as artist, and you have Severance as the businessman, making everything run on time,
sentences.zh: 作为伙伴，他们合作得天衣无缝，因为你有作为艺术家的建筑师范·阿伦，还有作为商人的塞弗伦斯，让一切按时运转，

sentences.en: making things work efficiently.
sentences.zh: 让事情高效运作。

sentences.en: And together, they were able to do quite a bit.
sentences.zh: 他们齐心协力，成就了一番大事业。

sentences.en: But they were not just business partners.
sentences.zh: 但他们不仅是商业伙伴。

sentences.en: They stood up at each other's weddings.
sentences.zh: 他们还出席了彼此的婚礼。

sentences.en: Van Allen was the godfather to Severance's daughter.
sentences.zh: 范·阿伦是塞弗伦斯女儿的教父。

sentences.en: But years of working together had taken its toll.
sentences.zh: 然而多年的合作也付出了代价。

sentences.en: Sadly, we don't know exactly what the sort of precipitating factor was,
sentences.zh: 遗憾的是，我们并不知道具体是什么导火索，

sentences.en: other than the fact that there were some records that I discovered just about Van Allen wanting to change plans, sort of continuously running over budget.
sentences.zh: 只知道我发现了一些关于范·阿伦想要修改计划、预算接连超支的记录。

sentences.en: And to someone like Severance, that wasn't going to stand.
sentences.zh: 对于塞弗伦斯这样的人来说，这是绝不能容忍的。

sentences.en: And so they were late on plans.
sentences.zh: 因此他们的方案延误了。

sentences.en: They weren't delivering.
sentences.zh: 他们没有按时交货。

sentences.en: And I think that Severance at a certain point said, you know, I could do this better on my own.
sentences.zh: 我想塞弗伦斯在某个时刻曾说过，你知道的，我自己能把这事干得更好。

sentences.en: Telling our story today is Neil Bascom.
sentences.zh: 今天给我们讲述这个故事的是尼尔·巴斯科姆。

sentences.en: My name is Neil Bascom.
sentences.zh: 我叫尼尔·巴斯科姆。

sentences.en: He wrote a great book about this called Hire, a historic race to the sky and the making of a city.
sentences.zh: 他写过一本关于这事的好书，名为《高耸：通往天空的历史竞赛与一座城市的诞生》。

sentences.en: I'm the author of Hire and a number of other books.
sentences.zh: 我是《高耸》以及其他几本书的作者。

sentences.en: At the time of the Van Allen and Severance breakup, New York City was undergoing a boom like nothing ever seen before.
sentences.zh: 在范·阿伦和塞弗伦斯分道扬镳之际，纽约市正经历着前所未有的空前繁荣。

sentences.en: Massive wealth concentrated on this tiny island turned Manhattan into the most valuable property in human history.
sentences.zh: 巨额财富集中在这个小岛上，把曼哈顿变成了人类历史上价值最高的资产。

sentences.en: And when property gets valuable, we build up.
sentences.zh: 而当房地产变得有价值时，我们就会向上建造。

sentences.en: The roaring 20s, the stock market is going crazy.
sentences.zh: 咆哮的二十年代，股市疯狂飙升。

sentences.en: Real estate prices are going through the roof.
sentences.zh: 房地产价格飞涨。

sentences.en: A skyscraper is a machine designed to turn land into money.
sentences.zh: 摩天大楼就是一台旨在将土地变成金钱的机器。

sentences.en: At least, that's how Severance viewed skyscrapers.
sentences.zh: 至少，塞弗伦斯是这样看待摩天大楼的。

sentences.en: There were talks of skyscrapers of 1,200 feet, 1,500 feet.
sentences.zh: 当时有人谈论建造1200英尺、1500英尺高的摩天大楼。

sentences.en: I mean, off the charts.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，简直破了纪录。

sentences.en: It was a symbol both of the economics and also of the times.
sentences.zh: 这既是经济的象征，也是那个时代的象征。

sentences.en: I mean, the culture was we want everything faster, higher, better.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当时的文化就是我们要一切都更快、更高、更好。

sentences.en: And so it sort of all came together into the skyscraper race.
sentences.zh: 所以这一切汇聚到了一起，演变成了摩天大楼竞赛。

sentences.en: At this point in 1928, late 1928, Van Allen's career is basically, you know, in the basement.
sentences.zh: 到了1928年这个时候，1928年底，范·阿伦的职业生涯基本上可以说是跌入谷底了。

sentences.en: I mean, he's not getting many commissions.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他接不到什么委托。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Severance is going crazy.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，塞弗伦斯却疯狂接单。

sentences.en: I mean, he's getting commission after commission on big building after big building.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他接了一个又一个大项目的建筑委托。

sentences.en: So in late 1928, Walter Chrysler, founder of the Chrysler Car Company, came to New York City and bought a plot of land and wanted to build what he referred to as a monument to me.
sentences.zh: 因此在1928年底，克莱斯勒汽车公司的创始人沃尔特·克莱斯勒来到纽约市，买下一块地皮，并想要建造他口中“为我树立的纪念碑”。

sentences.en: Van Allen had already been working on plans for the previous owner of that plot.
sentences.zh: 范·阿伦此前已经开始为该地块的前业主设计方案了。

sentences.en: And Chrysler decided to hire him to develop that plan into what would become the Chrysler building.
sentences.zh: 而克莱斯勒决定聘请他将该方案开发成后来的克莱斯勒大厦。

sentences.en: Chrysler, I think, was in his own way a revolutionary.
sentences.zh: 我想克莱斯勒以他自己的方式来说也是个革新者。

sentences.en: It was very committed to art and design and I think saw in a very real way a kindred spirit in Van Allen.
sentences.zh: 他非常执着于艺术和设计，并且我认为他在很大程度上从范·阿伦身上看到了志同道合的灵魂。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, downtown at 40 Wall Street, Van Allen's ex-partner, Craig Severance, was building the Manhattan Company building.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，在市中心华尔街40号，范·阿伦的前合伙人克雷格·塞弗伦斯正在建造曼哈顿信托大厦。

sentences.en: And Severance's building was very different, keyed exactly to his personality.
sentences.zh: 塞弗伦斯的建筑风格大不相同，完全契合他的性格。

sentences.en: The Manhattan Company building was downtown.
sentences.zh: 曼哈顿信托大厦在市中心。

sentences.en: The Chrysler building was uptown.
sentences.zh: 克莱斯勒大厦在市 uptown（城北/中城）。

sentences.en: Severance was an investor in this building.
sentences.zh: 塞弗伦斯是这栋建筑的投资者之一。

sentences.en: It was being funded primarily by a man named George Orstrom who was considered the boy wonder of Wall Street.
sentences.zh: 它主要由一个名叫乔治·奥斯特罗姆的人资助，他被认为是华尔街的神童。

sentences.en: He was 34.
sentences.zh: 他当时34岁。

sentences.en: He was incredibly rich, incredibly quickly.
sentences.zh: 他以惊人的速度变得极其富有。

sentences.en: And their building was, in a very real way, was to make money.
sentences.zh: 在很大程度上，他们的建筑就是为了赚钱。

sentences.en: While the Chrysler building was to sort of make a monument to what Chrysler had achieved, but also to sort of break new ground in architecture.
sentences.zh: 而克莱斯勒大厦则是为了纪念克莱斯勒所取得的成就，同时也为了在建筑领域开辟新天地。

sentences.en: At the time, Cass Gilbert's Woolworth building towered over everything.
sentences.zh: 当时，卡斯·吉尔伯特的伍尔沃斯大厦高高耸立，压倒一切。

sentences.en: 792 feet tall.
sentences.zh: 高792英尺。

sentences.en: It's the tallest building in New York.
sentences.zh: 它是纽约最高的建筑。

sentences.en: And in true monument-to-me fashion, Chrysler set his sights on his building being taller than the Woolworth building, the tallest in the city.
sentences.zh: 出于典型的“为我树立纪念碑”的心态，克莱斯勒将目标定为让自己的大厦超过伍尔沃斯大厦，成为全市最高。

sentences.en: And even though the Manhattan Company building didn't quite have the same motivation to be the tallest, to celebrate one man's greatness,
sentences.zh: 尽管曼哈顿信托大厦并没有同样强烈的动机要去成为最高、去庆祝某个人的伟大，

sentences.en: the team decided that they wanted to take the crown from Woolworth and be the talleSt.
sentences.zh: 但团队还是决定他们想要从伍尔沃斯手中夺走桂冠，成为最高。

sentences.en: I think the motivation initially for the Wall Street building, for the Manhattan Company building, is, one, because of the cost of land downtown in Wall Street,
sentences.zh: 我认为华尔街大厦，即曼哈顿信托大厦最初的动机，第一，是因为华尔街市中心土地成本高昂，

sentences.en: you have to build high.
sentences.zh: 你必须建得很高。

sentences.en: They, you know, got their spreadsheets out and decided exactly how high that would be.
sentences.zh: 他们拿出电子表格，精确计算出了应该建多高。

sentences.en: And then they decided to go a little bit higher to have the imprimatur of the world's tallest building, which, when you're selling office space, is something that,
sentences.zh: 然后他们决定再建高一点，以便获得“世界最高建筑”的光环，当你出售办公空间时，这东西，

sentences.en: as a real estate agent, you can sort of hand out a card and says, do you want to work in the world's tallest building?
sentences.zh: 作为房地产经纪人，你可以发一张名片，上面写着：你想在世界最高的建筑里办公吗？

sentences.en: So it was a sales tactic, as well as an economic decision.
sentences.zh: 所以这既是一个销售策略，也是一个经济决策。

sentences.en: And so the race was on.
sentences.zh: 于是竞赛开始了。

sentences.en: Two ex-partners, Van Allen with the Chrysler building and Severance with the Manhattan Company building, were going to battle it out for supremacy on the skyline.
sentences.zh: 两个前合伙人，带着克莱斯勒大厦的范·阿伦和带着曼哈顿信托大厦的塞弗伦斯，将在天际线的统治地位上展开决战。

sentences.en: Initially, the Chrysler building was the first to announce its height.
sentences.zh: 最初，克莱斯勒大厦是第一个宣布其高度的。

sentences.en: Chrysler and Van Allen were a little bit further along.
sentences.zh: 克莱斯勒和范·阿伦的进度稍微超前一点。

sentences.en: And so they announced in early 1929 that they're going to roughly 820 feet, which is taller than the Woolworth at 792.
sentences.zh: 因此他们在1929年初宣布，他们将建到大约820英尺高，这比792英尺的伍尔沃斯大厦还要高。

sentences.en: Well, a couple months after that, Craig Severance comes out and says, well, we're building to 840 feet.
sentences.zh: 好吧，几个月后，克雷格·塞弗伦斯跳出来说，我们要建到840英尺高。

sentences.en: And then you have this over the course of that year, particularly that summer, even as the buildings are going up, even as they're setting the foundation,
sentences.zh: 然后在那一年，特别是那个夏天，随着大厦不断拔地而起，甚至在打地基的时候，

sentences.en: even as they're ordering steel, Van Allen and Severance are both changing their plans, both not knowing what the other person is doing,
sentences.zh: 甚至在订购钢材的时候，范·阿伦和塞弗伦斯都在不断修改图纸，双方都不知道对方在干什么，

sentences.en: but sure that their respective bosses want to go higher.
sentences.zh: 但都确信各自的老板都想建得更高。

sentences.en: And I think at this point, they very much want to beat each other.
sentences.zh: 我想到了这个时候，他们非常渴望击败对方。

sentences.en: But it wasn't just a height race.
sentences.zh: 但这不仅是一场高度竞赛。

sentences.en: It was also a speed race.
sentences.zh: 这也是一场速度竞赛。

sentences.en: At the point in the summer of 1929, when both of these buildings are going up very fast, it's very much who can beat the Woolworth building first?
sentences.zh: 在1929年夏天的那个时候，这两座大厦都在飞速建造，这很大程度上变成了谁能最先击败伍尔沃斯大厦？

sentences.en: Who can, you know, release that first statement saying, world's tallest building?
sentences.zh: 谁能率先发表声明说：世界最高建筑？

sentences.en: And the public was into it.
sentences.zh: 公众也非常关注。

sentences.en: It was a race almost weekly.
sentences.zh: 这场竞赛几乎每周都在进行。

sentences.en: 150 feet.
Severance wins.
sentences.zh: 塞弗伦斯赢了。

sentences.en: Van Allen wins.
sentences.zh: 范·阿伦赢了。

sentences.en: I mean, all these sort of premature statements.
sentences.zh: 我是说，所有这些都是为时过早的声明。

sentences.en: And it was very much covered in the press and in all of the New York newspapers at that time, which were many.
sentences.zh: 当时的媒体以及纽约所有的报纸都对此进行了大量报道，当时的报纸数量繁多。

sentences.en: Big, you know, front page photographs.
sentences.zh: 醒目的头版照片。

sentences.en: It was pretty incredible.
sentences.zh: 这真是太不可思议了。

sentences.en: But both Chrysler and Van Allen were not content just being the fastest and the talleSt.
sentences.zh: 但克莱斯勒和范·阿伦并不满足于仅仅做到最快和最高。

sentences.en: Van Allen remembers a time going into Chrysler's office when Chrysler's on the floor, you know, with plans spread out on the carpet, you know,
sentences.zh: 范·阿伦回忆起有一次走进克莱斯勒的办公室时，克莱斯勒正趴在地板上，把图纸铺在地毯上，

sentences.en: looking at how the lobby is going to be set up.
sentences.zh: 研究大堂该如何布置。

sentences.en: Walter Chrysler was very interested in art and architecture.
sentences.zh: 沃尔特·克莱斯勒对艺术和建筑非常感兴趣。

sentences.en: And so he wanted a beautiful building.
sentences.zh: 因此他想要一栋美丽的建筑。

sentences.en: He wanted a building like none other in the world.
sentences.zh: 他想要一栋世上绝无仅有的建筑。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, at the Manhattan Company building.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，在曼哈顿信托大厦这边。

sentences.en: Basically, what's happening on the Manhattan Company building is they're just adding floors.
sentences.zh: 曼哈顿信托大厦发生的事情基本上就是他们一直在加盖楼层。

sentences.en: They're saying, well, the foundation will be able to do this if we add four floors, if we add 10 floors, we add this little flag at the top, we can go higher.
sentences.zh: 他们说，如果我们加盖四层、加盖十层、在顶部加上这个小旗杆，地基也能撑得住，我们就能建得更高。

sentences.en: So it was almost incremental movements on the Manhattan Company building.
sentences.zh: 所以曼哈顿信托大厦的调整几乎是渐进式的。

sentences.en: On the Chrysler building, they were achieving last-minute height advantages in two ways.
sentences.zh: 而在克莱斯勒大厦，他们通过两种方式在最后一刻争取高度优势。

sentences.en: One, originally the dome of the Chrysler building, that arch dome, was much more compact.
sentences.zh: 第一，最初克莱斯勒大厦的那个穹顶，那个拱形穹顶，要紧凑得多。

sentences.en: As you see it now, it's almost like it's stretched out.
sentences.zh: 正如你现在所看到的，它几乎像是被拉长了一样。

sentences.en: And that happened because of the height race.
sentences.zh: 这都是因为高度竞赛才变成这样的。

sentences.en: They wanted to find more floors.
sentences.zh: 他们想要找出更多的楼层空间。

sentences.en: They wanted to get some more height.
sentences.zh: 他们想要获得更多的高度。

sentences.en: And so that elegant, elongated dome that we love on the Chrysler building was the result of this silly height race.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们所喜爱的克莱斯勒大厦那优雅、修长的穹顶，就是这场无聊的高度竞赛的结果。

sentences.en: But the sneaky masterstroke that ultimately led the Chrysler building to surpass the Manhattan Company building for good was the gleaming spire called the Vertex.
sentences.zh: 但最终让克莱斯勒大厦彻底超越曼哈顿信托大厦的秘密绝招，是一个被称为“顶点”（Vertex）的闪亮尖塔。

sentences.en: And that was a 185-foot triangular spire that was built inside the stairwell, basically, the fire stairwell, inside the building at the top of the building.
sentences.zh: 那是一个185英尺高的三角形尖塔，它是在大楼内部的楼梯间，基本上是消防楼梯间里、在大楼顶部建造的。

sentences.en: So the Manhattan Company building had no idea what was going on.
sentences.zh: 所以曼哈顿信托大厦根本不知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: They brought up each piece separately up the side of the building by derricks, constructed it inside the fire tower.
sentences.zh: 他们用起重机把每一块构件分别吊运到大楼侧面，在防火塔内部将其组装起来。

sentences.en: And one day, after the Manhattan Company building was finished, topped out, no chance to add any more floors, suddenly,
sentences.zh: 有一天，在曼哈顿信托大厦完工、封顶、再也没有机会加盖任何楼层之后，突然之间，

sentences.en: this concealed vertex is brought up from inside the building.
sentences.zh: 这个隐藏的顶点从大楼内部被升了上去。

sentences.en: And as Van Allen said, sort of like a butterfly emerging from its cocoon, they put this thing on top of the building.
sentences.zh: 正如范·阿伦所说，有点像破茧而出的蝴蝶，他们把这东西安在了大楼顶部。

sentences.en: It was 185-foot tall, and it made the Chrysler building 1,046 feet high in the tallest structure in the world, now surpassing the Eiffel Tower.
sentences.zh: 它高185英尺，这使得克莱斯勒大厦的高度达到1046英尺，成为世界上最高的建筑，从而超越了埃菲尔铁塔。

sentences.en: And if you're thinking, this stunt of secretly riveting a giant metal spire 900 feet in the air sounds ridiculously dangerous, you are right.
sentences.zh: 如果你觉得在900英尺的高空秘密铆接一个巨型金属尖塔这种特技听起来荒谬危险，那你说得对。

sentences.en: It's extremely dangerous.
sentences.zh: 这极其危险。

sentences.en: I can imagine today it not getting approval.
sentences.zh: 我可以想象放在今天根本通不过审批。

sentences.en: Everyone basically thinking from Chrysler to Van Allen, is this thing going to fall?
sentences.zh: 从克莱斯勒到范·阿伦，每个人心里都在想：这东西会掉下来吗？

sentences.en: And if it does, you're going to impale half a street or more.
sentences.zh: 如果掉下来，你会把半条街甚至更多的人串在上面。

sentences.en: And you can imagine the damage that would have done.
sentences.zh: 你可以想象那会造成多大的破坏。

sentences.en: Now, you probably know and can clearly picture the now classic Art Deco style of the Chrysler building.
sentences.zh: 现在，你可能知道并且能清晰地想象出克莱斯勒大厦那标志性的装饰艺术风格。

sentences.en: The steel-clad arches, the sunburst triangular windows, not to mention the hood ornament-style eagles, and the hubcap friezes.
sentences.zh: 钢板包覆的拱门、日冕状的三角形窗户，更不用说汽车引擎盖装饰风格的雄鹰和轮毂盖饰带了。

sentences.en: It was made for a car guy, after all.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，它是为汽车大亨打造的。

sentences.en: But it's doubtful that you even heard of the Manhattan Company building.
sentences.zh: 但你可能压根没听说过曼哈顿信托大厦。

sentences.en: First, because now it's called 40 Wall Street, or the Trump building.
sentences.zh: 首先，因为它现在被称为华尔街40号，或者特朗普大厦。

sentences.en: But also, because it just never took hold in the public consciousness, even though I actually really dig its green roof.
sentences.zh: 但也是因为，它从未真正深入人心，尽管我其实真的很喜欢它那绿色的屋顶。

sentences.en: Curiously, the Manhattan Company building, 40 Wall Street, got all the accolades.
sentences.zh: 奇怪的是，曼哈顿信托大厦，即华尔街40号，获得了所有的赞誉。

sentences.en: It won awards.
sentences.zh: 它赢得了奖项。

sentences.en: The design was mostly by this Japanese architect, Yasui Matsui.
sentences.zh: 其设计主要出自这位日本建筑师松井源吾之手。

sentences.en: So it did, you know, wonderful in the trades.
sentences.zh: 所以它在业内表现得相当不错。

sentences.en: And it was just basically a fairly bland-looking building at the time.
sentences.zh: 而它在当时基本上只是一栋看起来相当平庸的建筑。

sentences.en: And then you have the Chrysler building with this new dome, this new vertex, something that really New York or the world had never seen.
sentences.zh: 然后你再看看克莱斯勒大厦，带着这个崭新的穹顶、这个崭新的顶点，这是纽约乃至全世界从未见过的事物。

sentences.en: It was pretty remarkable stuff.
sentences.zh: 这真是相当了不起。

sentences.en: And it was almost universally panned.
sentences.zh: 然而它几乎遭到了普遍的严厉批评。

sentences.en: It was considered a stunt design.
sentences.zh: 它被认为是一种哗众取宠的设计。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: Some people called it a monstrosity.
sentences.zh: 有些人甚至称其为一个怪物。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: It was largely reviled by architectural critics.
sentences.zh: 它曾遭到建筑评论家们的猛烈抨击。

sentences.en: What do they know?
sentences.zh: 他们懂个屁？

sentences.en: And it was only over time that the Chrysler building became the sort of treasured landmark that it is.
sentences.zh: 克莱斯勒大厦直到后来，才变成了现在这种备受珍视的地标。

sentences.en: And if the story stopped there, you might think Van Allen, the artistic maverick, won the day.
sentences.zh: 如果故事到此为止，你可能会觉得身为艺术鬼才的范·艾伦赢了。

sentences.en: The Chrysler building was the tallest structure in the world.
sentences.zh: 克莱斯勒大厦曾是世界上最高的建筑。

sentences.en: And even though the design was panned originally, we all know that it eventually got its due.
sentences.zh: 尽管最初的设计饱受非议，但我们都知道它最终得到了应有的认可。

sentences.en: But the story does not end there.
sentences.zh: 但故事并没有结束。

sentences.en: After all this hubbub of partner-against-partner fighting for who would be the tallest,
sentences.zh: 在经历了一轮又一轮合伙人之间争夺世界第一高楼的混战之后，

sentences.en: a mere 11 months later, the great Empire State Building was completed,
sentences.zh: 仅仅11个月后，伟大的帝国大厦就落成了，

sentences.en: and it became the tallest building in the world for nearly 40 years.
sentences.zh: 它成为了将近40年里世界上最高的建筑。

sentences.en: Frankly, I don't care about that so much.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，我没那么关心这个。

sentences.en: What happened next was the real tragedy.
sentences.zh: 接下来发生的事才是真正的悲剧。

sentences.en: The lack of business acumen that probably contributed to Van Allen and Severin's parting ways
sentences.zh: 正是缺乏商业头脑，导致了范·艾伦和塞弗伦斯的决裂，

sentences.en: really came back to bite William Van Allen.
sentences.zh: 这最终给威廉·范·艾伦带来了恶果。

sentences.en: He never actually had a contract with Walter Chrysler to design the Chrysler building.
sentences.zh: 实际上，他和沃尔特·克莱斯勒之间从来没有签过设计克莱斯勒大厦的合同。

sentences.en: Chrysler, at the end of the day, said,
sentences.zh: 克莱斯勒最终说道：

sentences.en: well, I'm not going to pay you your fee because we didn't have a signed contract.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不会付你设计费的，因为我们没有签合同。

sentences.en: It was widely sort of considered normal at the time for the architect to be paid
sentences.zh: 当时大家普遍认为，建筑师的酬劳通常是

sentences.en: roughly 6% of the cost of the building.
sentences.zh: 建筑总成本的6%左右。

sentences.en: That sum of money is what Van Allen expected.
sentences.zh: 这笔钱正是范·艾伦所期望的。

sentences.en: It's what Chrysler wasn't willing to pay.
sentences.zh: 而这也是克莱斯勒不愿支付的。

sentences.en: Van Allen ended up suing Chrysler.
sentences.zh: 范·艾伦最终把克莱斯勒告上了法庭。

sentences.en: It hit the newspapers, and at the end of the day,
sentences.zh: 这登上了各大报纸，最终，

sentences.en: Cass Gilbert, who did the Woolworths, came and said, you know,
sentences.zh: 设计了伍尔沃斯大厦的卡斯·吉尔伯特出面说，你知道的，

sentences.en: yes, that percentage is the typical rate.
sentences.zh: 没错，那个百分比确实是标准费率。

sentences.en: That's what Van Allen should be paid.
sentences.zh: 这就应该是范·艾伦应得的报酬。

sentences.en: Van Allen was paid that.
sentences.zh: 范·艾伦最后拿到了这笔钱。

sentences.en: But Van Allen was never given a major commission again.
sentences.zh: 但范·艾伦再也没有接到过什么重要的大项目。

sentences.en: I think both because the Great Depression had hit,
sentences.zh: 我想一方面是因为大萧条的爆发，

sentences.en: and also because he had now sued his patron,
sentences.zh: 另一方面也是因为他居然把自己的赞助商告了，

sentences.en: and that was something that I think others shied away from.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这让其他人对敬而远之。

sentences.en: Van Allen spent most of the rest of his life teaching sculpture at the Beaux-Arts Institute of Design.
sentences.zh: 范·艾伦的余生大部分时间都在美术设计学院教授雕塑。

sentences.en: But Severance, on the other hand, continued to succeed.
sentences.zh: 但塞弗伦斯则截然不同，他继续顺风顺水。

sentences.en: The Manhattan Company building did terribly,
sentences.zh: 曼哈顿公司大楼的业务惨淡极了，

sentences.en: like every other office building in New York at the time.
sentences.zh: 就像当时纽约的其他所有写字楼一样。

sentences.en: But Severance, you know, went into the Depression and got a bunch of government work,
sentences.zh: 但你知道的，塞弗伦斯在进入大萧条时期后接到了大量政府订单，

sentences.en: actually built a bunch of hangers for balloons and such.
sentences.zh: 实际上是为气球之类的大型装备建造了一堆机库。

sentences.en: And so he did quite well and lived nicely and died in luxury.
sentences.zh: 所以他干得相当不错，生活优渥，安享晚年。

sentences.en: So that's at least one happy ending for you.
sentences.zh: 所以，这至少算是一个圆满的结局。

sentences.en: But we do have the happy ending of the fact that the Chrysler building is this sort of hollowed structure now.
sentences.zh: 但我们真正值得庆幸的圆满结局是，克莱斯勒大厦现在成了这样一座内部掏空的宏伟建筑。

sentences.en: And Van Allen really did get the commission of a lifetime.
sentences.zh: 而且范·艾伦确实接到了他一生中最重要的委托。

sentences.en: There was no expense spared by Chrysler.
sentences.zh: 克莱斯勒在资金上可以说是挥金如土。

sentences.en: If you ever go into the Chrysler building, you know, from the lobby all the way to the top,
sentences.zh: 如果你去过克莱斯勒大厦，从大厅一直到顶楼，

sentences.en: I mean, it's just expense and expense and expense.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，到处都是钱，到处都是钱。

sentences.en: I mean, just beautiful Art Deco interior work, wood paneling, Art Deco murals.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，单是那精美的装饰艺术风格内饰、木质镶板、装饰艺术壁画，

sentences.en: It's just an incredible building, top to bottom, inside and out.
sentences.zh: 从上到下、从里到外，简直是一座不可思议的建筑。

sentences.en: And very rarely do you have a commission where money is no object.
sentences.zh: 你很难遇到一个完全不计成本的项目。

sentences.en: And so Van Allen was given one shot, and I think he came through.
sentences.zh: 所以范·艾伦得到了这次机会，而我认为他完美地把握住了。

sentences.en: If Craig Severance was standing in front of me, I think I'd say,
sentences.zh: 如果克雷格·塞弗伦斯现在站在我面前，我想我会对他说：

sentences.en: I wish you worked it out with Van Allen.
sentences.zh: 我真希望你当初能和范·艾伦好好协商解决。

sentences.en: You did well.
sentences.zh: 你干得不错。

sentences.en: You deserved it.
sentences.zh: 这是你应得的。

sentences.en: But I think you would have been greater together.
sentences.zh: 但我相信，你们联手本可以创造更伟大的成就。

sentences.en: And if I could talk to Van Allen, I'd say,
sentences.zh: 如果我能和范·艾伦对话，我会对他说：

sentences.en: I'm sorry you didn't get to build more great structures.
sentences.zh: 很遗憾你没能建造更多伟大的建筑。

sentences.en: But know that you created the building that can stop the most architecturally blind and generally disinterested person dead in their tracks,
sentences.zh: 但你要知道，你创造了一座能让最不懂建筑、最漠不关心的人都为之驻足惊叹的建筑，

sentences.en: and they will marvel at your accomplishment.
sentences.zh: 他们会为你的成就赞叹不已。

sentences.en: Know that.
sentences.zh: 记住这一点。

sentences.en: And to Walter Chrysler, I'd say,
sentences.zh: 至于沃尔特·克莱斯勒，我想对他说：

sentences.en: F*** you.
sentences.zh: 操你的。

sentences.en: Pay your bills, you f***ing deadbeat.
sentences.zh: 付清你的账单，你这个该死的赖账鬼。

sentences.en: I could have, we could have had another Chrysler building or something as good if you hadn't ruined Van Allen's life.
sentences.zh: 如果你没有毁掉范·艾伦的生活，我们本可以拥有另一座克莱斯勒大厦或同样伟大的作品。

sentences.en: I mean, probably not because of the Great Depression and all, but we'll never know, will we?
sentences.zh: 我是说，可能因为大萧条之类的原因也说不定，但我们永远不会知道了，对吧？

sentences.en: You bum.
sentences.zh: 你这个废物。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible is Sam Greenspan, Avery Truffleman, and me, Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 《99%无形》由萨姆·格林斯潘、艾弗里·特拉弗尔曼和我罗马·马尔斯共同制作。

sentences.en: We are a project of 91.7 local public radio, KALW in San Francisco,
sentences.zh: 我们是旧金山 91.7 本地公共广播电台 KALW 的一个项目，

sentences.en: and produced out of the offices of ArcSign, a brilliant architecture firm in beautiful downtown Oakland, California.
sentences.zh: 制作工作室位于加利福尼亚州奥克兰市美丽市中心的杰出建筑事务所 ArcSign。

sentences.en: When we get a little out of hand, they sometimes ask us to use our inside voices.
sentences.zh: 当我们有点得意忘形时，他们有时会提醒我们用小声说话。

sentences.en: But to that I say, you should try working next to Snap Judgment.
sentences.zh: 但对此我想说，你大可以去跟《瞬间判决》做邻居试试。

sentences.en: You can find the show and like the show on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 你可以在 Facebook 上找到并关注这个节目。

sentences.en: I tweet at Roman Mars, Sam tweets at Sam Listens, Avery tweets at Truffleman.
sentences.zh: 我发推的账号是 Roman Mars，萨姆是 Sam Listens，艾弗里是 Truffleman。

sentences.en: But right now, it is the first episode of Season 4.
sentences.zh: 但现在，这是第四季的第一集。

sentences.en: We are going weekly from here on out, so now is a great time to tell everyone you know and love
sentences.zh: 从现在开始我们将每周更新，所以现在正是把节目推荐给你所有认识和喜爱的人的最佳时机，

sentences.en: to start listening to 99% Invisible,
sentences.zh: 让他们开始收听《99%无形》，

sentences.en: and everything you need to become a 99% Invisible fan is available at 99pi.org.
sentences.zh: 成为《99%无形》粉丝所需的一切都可以在 99pi.org 上找到。

sentences.en: Radiotopia.
sentences.zh: 电台乌托邦。
